narrator.instruction: A mature Russian male voice. Deep, calm, reflective, slightly melancholic. Slow literary narration, soft authority, philosophical tone. Native Russian pronunciation.

author.instruction: A mature Russian male voice. Deep, calm, reflective, slightly melancholic. Slow literary narration, soft authority, philosophical tone. Native Russian pronunciation.

berlioz.instruction: A mature Russian male voice. Medium-low pitch, confident and controlled. Calm, rational, intellectually sharp.

bezdomny.instruction: A young Russian male voice. Energetic, fast, emotionally charged, sometimes unstable, speaking with conviction but lacking full control.

woland.instruction: A mature male voice with subtle foreign accent. Calm, deep, hypnotic, ironic and composed. Speaks slowly with absolute confidence and hidden menace. Sophisticated intellectual tone.
